nodes.title: Operators library file/LOC census (43 modules / 51 py files / 60 tracked / 21,891 LOC)
nodes.claim: AGENTS.md's 'reconciled 2026-08-28' census states: 43 top-level .py modules, 51 .py files total, 60 tracked files total, 21,891 LOC.
nodes.note: FALSE as read today. Current measured state (git ls-files, __pycache__ excluded): 52 tracked .py files under operators/ (not 51), 62 tracked files total (not 60), 22,171 LOC (not 21,891). Further, the doc's own prescribed recount command `git ls-files 'operators/**/*.py' | grep -v __pycache__ | wc -l` returns 9 today — it only matches files nested two+ directories deep (core/, job_search/, linkedin_pipeline/), not the ~52 top-level modules, so the documented verification method does not actually reproduce the documented number even in principle. Files like operators/kryptonite_scorer.py and operators/arcs_substrate.py were first added 2026-06-16/07-08, predating the 'reconciled 2026-08-28' census, meaning the census undercounted even at authoring time, and has drifted further since (new files added post-2026-08-28 not checked further here).

nodes.title: Oracle pre-commit gate: blocks exact duplicates, only WARNS on off-oracle/above-counter numbers
nodes.claim: AGENTS.md gotcha #12 claims 'A pre-commit hook enforces this: blocks any commit that duplicates an existing ADR number; warns on off-oracle numbers.'

Confirmed the hook is armed in this environment: `git config --get core.hooksPath` returns scripts/git-hooks. But this is exactly the enforcement gap ADR-034 warns about in the abstract: the warn-only branch is precisely how ADR-074 slipped past the oracle counter and the index.json backfill without being caught — a live illustration, not a hypothetical, of 'a rule that isn't enforced isn't a rule.'
